semantics.affinity: FLOWR head prediction, not independently measured binding affinity
semantics.causality: Retrospective associations, no network attention or causal module evidence
semantics.contacts: All-heavy smooth distances/contacts, not verified hydrogen bonds or interaction energies
semantics.contrasts: Matched batch mean differences with equal graph weight within each label; paired Wilcoxon, BH by coordinate/graph family; deterministic batch bootstrap seed 42
semantics.endpoint: Model endpoint prediction; not current noisy state or decoded final molecule
semantics.quality_budget: Original native P90 strain, fixed before examining Steer tail qualification
semantics.selection_labels: Retrospective observed elite descendants, other observed valid descendants, and future-censored extinct nodes; shared ancestors allocated to elite class
semantics.strain: Converged MMFF94s local relaxation relief per heavy atom, not binding free energy
semantics.suffix: Only three post-selection score diagnostics, excluded from selection feature mining
